{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'status', 'revenue_numeric']])

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter to completed orders only, excluding QA orders
completed_data_clean = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99)]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = completed_data_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Output the results
print(channel_revenue)"}
